objectives_fil: Para sa Lagundi, itugma ang botanical name, bahagi at nakalistang gamit. Ipaliwanag ang hangganan at konsultasyon.
objectives_en: For Lagundi, match the botanical name, plant part and listed use. Explain the boundary and consultation need.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: Umuubo si Ben at hirap huminga
sections.takeaway_en: Case: Ben is coughing and has difficulty breathing

sections.takeaway_fil: Itugma ang dalawang Lagundi card; piliin ang Vitex negundo, dahon, gamit at ligtas na susunod na hakbang.
sections.takeaway_en: Match two Lagundi cards; choose Vitex negundo, leaves, use and safe next step.

sections.takeaway_fil: Dahon ng Vitex negundo ang nasa card; hindi ito dose.
sections.takeaway_en: The card lists leaves of Vitex negundo; this is not a dose.

check.prompt_fil: Aling bahagi ng Lagundi ang nakalista sa card?
check.prompt_en: Which Lagundi part is listed on the card?

options.fil: Anumang bahagi ng halaman, dahil kilala ang Lagundi sa ubo.
options.en: Any part of the plant, since Lagundi is well known for cough.

options.fil: Ang pinagpakuluan at dose mula sa lumang slide.
options.en: The decoction and dose shown on the old slide.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi sinasabi ng pagiging kilala ang nakalistang bahagi; dahon ang nasa card. 2: Dahon ng Vitex negundo ang nasa card; hindi ito dose. 3: Bahagi ang nasa card, hindi pinagpakuluan; huwag gayahin ang dose ng lumang slide.
check.feedback_en: 1: Being well known does not tell you the listed part; the card lists leaves. 2: The card lists leaves of Vitex negundo; this is not a dose. 3: The card lists a part, not a decoction; do not copy the old slide’s dose.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso ni Ben: tugma ang card, walang pinagpakuluan, iniugnay agad at iniulat.
sections.takeaway_en: Ben’s case: card matched, no decoction, Ben connected promptly and reported.

sections.takeaway_fil: Hindi dapat maantala ng herbal na inumin ang pagsusuri sa hirap sa paghinga.
sections.takeaway_en: An herbal drink must not delay assessment of breathing difficulty.

sections.takeaway_fil: Iugnay agad si Ben at iulat ang hirap sa paghinga.
sections.takeaway_en: Connect Ben promptly and report his breathing difficulty.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang ligtas na tugon sa kaso ni Ben?
check.prompt_en: What is the safe response in Ben’s case?

options.fil: Painumin si Ben ng Lagundi na pinagpakuluan habang naghihintay.
options.en: Let Ben drink the Lagundi decoction while you wait.

options.fil: Iugnay agad si Ben sa health professional; iulat ang hirap huminga.
options.en: Connect Ben promptly and report his breathing difficulty.

options.fil: Subukan muna ang Lagundi at iugnay lamang kung hindi gumaan ang ubo.
options.en: Try Lagundi first and refer only if the cough does not ease.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi dapat makaantala ng pagsusuri ang herbal na inumin; hindi ito ibinibigay ng BHW. 2: Hindi makapaghihintay ang hirap sa paghinga; iugnay agad si Ben at iulat ito. 3: Hindi lang ito ubo; naaantala ang pagsusuri sa paghinga kapag Lagundi muna.
check.feedback_en: 1: An herbal drink must not delay assessment; the BHW does not give it. 2: Difficulty breathing cannot wait; connect Ben promptly and report it. 3: This is not only a cough; trying Lagundi first delays assessment of his breathing.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa Lunes, ihambing ang dalawang Lagundi card at ipasuri sa supervisor.
sections.takeaway_en: On Monday, compare two Lagundi cards and review them with a supervisor.
